item.description: i used to believe that passively consuming information was a form of learning. it isn't. real learning is hard, it's uncomfortable; it requires wrestling with reality. if learning ever feels "easy", i just assume i'm probably not learning anything.
item.content:encoded:
@thejayalto

i used to believe that passively consuming information was a form of learning. it isn't. real learning is hard, it's uncomfortable; it requires wrestling with reality. if learning ever feels "easy", i just assume i'm probably not learning anything.
